mentions.name: Muves Research Assistant
mentions.description: A research assistant tool that helps users comprehend research papers faster, and works with any document in any language. It uses LLMs and vector search extensively, is currently free to use thanks to GCP credits, and the authors anticipate eventually introducing a subscription fee to keep it running.
mentions.problem: Research papers (and documents in other languages) are slow to comprehend.
mentions.source_excerpt:
On a Research Assistant: https://muves.io/

It helps to comprehend research papers (and not only papers - any document on any language) faster.
